short_description: Design doctrine describing how a large simulated world produces discovery, capability, infrastructure, consequences and history.
purpose: Keep gameplay/world-building principles reusable and aligned with technical foundations without giving design documentation ownership of identity, authority, material or persistence systems.
expected_outcome: A durable design reference used to judge whether new simulation mechanics create interesting interconnected gameplay rather than isolated features.
progress_note: Doctrine remains an active design reference and must map new mechanics onto canonical queries, operations, transactions and persistent world consequences.
next_stage: Continue doctrine updates only when new gameplay/system evidence appears
